independent.summary: The test uses `assert.notEqual` to pin a real dedup bug as expected behaviour: `normalizeTitle('  The Iron Gate')` keeps the article. The bug is reachable in production because draftNormalizer's zod schema (`title: z.string().min(1).max(200)`, draftNormalizer.js:21) never trims the title before `normalizeTitle(v.title)` runs at line 180. A whitespace-padded generated title therefore misses the exact-key match. It also misses the fuzzy fallback: 'the iron gate' against 'iron gate' scores 7/11 ≈ 0.64, below DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD 0.72. The result is a duplicate entity instead of an update, and whoever fixes the bug will find this test fails, so it discourages the fix. It should be a `test.todo`/skip, or the fix should ship with the test.
